interface.longDescription:
Explore your Matomo web analytics with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to understand site traffic, visitor activity, and acquisition channels.

Compare visits, actions, bounces, and visit duration across reporting periods. Review traffic by channel, device, referrer, or country using the fields available for your connected site. Calculate bounce rates, compare periods, and follow daily traffic trends.

publication.release_notes: Explore Matomo visits, actions, and bounce rates. Review traffic by device and channel, compare reporting periods, and follow daily activity in conversation.

prompts: Show Matomo visits, actions, and bounce rate for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matomo Demo Good.
Show Matomo visits by device type for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matomo Demo Good. Include only devices with visits.
Which channels brought visits to our site in the 30 days ending two days ago in Matomo Demo Good?
Compare Matomo visits and actions for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days in Matomo Demo Good.
Show daily Matomo visits and actions for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matomo Demo Good.

positive.description: Overall traffic and bounce-rate calculation. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with access to the Matomo Demo Good workspace and its docusnap.com site. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Recent means [D-31, D-2], inclusive; preceding means [D-61, D-32]. Resolve dates again at review time.
positive.prompt: Show Matomo visits, actions, and bounce rate for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matomo Demo Good.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select Matomo Demo Good, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_matomo for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=Matomo Demo Good and only assorted_requests.matomo_request. Read all returned tables under reportingData.Matomo.data, which may be segmented as Combined, VisitorOverview, Device, or Channel, and inspect note_of_assumption. State the actual dates and use only returned values. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Never send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. An error, missing access, or missing metric is not a successful result or evidence of zero activity. Request metrics=[Visits, Actions, Bounces], no breakdowns or time_granularity, and date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]]. Report Visits and Actions distinctly, without calling Actions pageviews or unique visitors. Calculate bounce rate as Bounces / Visits * 100 and label it as a percentage. A zero Visits denominator has no finite rate.

Request metrics=[Device visits], breakdowns=[Device type], no time_granularity, and date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]]. Read the Device table, sort visits descending, and show rows with Device visits greater than zero. Preserve the association between returned labels and counts; retain unknown/unclassified categories with visits. Any displayed total must sum the returned counts. Do not repeat site-wide Visits in each row.

positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select Matomo Demo Good, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_matomo for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=Matomo Demo Good and only assorted_requests.matomo_request. Read all returned tables under reportingData.Matomo.data, which may be segmented as Combined, VisitorOverview, Device, or Channel, and inspect note_of_assumption. Request metrics=[Visits, Actions], no breakdowns or time_granularity, and date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2], [D-61, D-32]]. Report the two period rows separately. Calculate recent minus previous for each metric and use the previous value as the percentage-change denominator. Do not combine the period totals or invent a finite percentage when the baseline is zero.

negative.prompt: Install the Matomo tracking code on every page of our website.
negative.description: Unsupported website or tag installation. Explain that this plugin retrieves reports and cannot edit the website or install tracking code. Do not call reporting, preview, workspace, catalog, or preference tools as a substitute, and do not claim tracking was installed.

negative.prompt: Delete all visits from last month in our Matomo site.
negative.description: Unsupported analytics data deletion. Explain that the reporting plugin cannot delete recorded visits. Do not call reporting or preference tools to pretend to perform deletion, and do not claim records were deleted.

negative.prompt: Give me the names and email addresses of everyone who visited our site last week.
negative.description: Unsupported visitor identification. Explain that these aggregate analytics tools cannot identify visitors by name or email. Do not call tools for unrelated reports or personal data, and do not invent identities.

review.commerce_description: Adzviser subscriptions are purchased separately on the Adzviser website. This plugin does not offer in-plugin purchases or checkout.
